title: Meghalaya Civil Secretariat Recruitment 2026 – Peon, Chowkidar and More Posts
shortInfo: Meghalaya Civil Secretariat has announced notification for Peon, Chowkidar and More posts. Required qualification: 6th. Last date to apply: 18-09-26.

dates.event: Last Date for Receipt of Applications

howToApply: Candidates are to apply and submit their applications online through the website at https://rpa.imeghalaya.gov.in
Applications received through any other mode will be summarily rejected.
For candidates applying for the first time through online mode, a one-time registration process is required.
Kindly read the instructions on the web page carefully before applying.
Last date for online registration is 18th September, 2026.
Pay the Examination Fee online via Debit/Credit Card, Net Banking, UPI, or E-Challan at any SBI branch.

title: Meghalaya Home Guards Recruitment 2026 – Home Guards Posts
shortInfo: Meghalaya Home Guards has announced notification for Home Guards posts. Required qualification: Other. Last date to apply: 28-09-26.

dates.event: Last Date for Receipt of Applications

howToApply: Obtain the Prescribed Standard Form for application.
Paste one recent passport-size photograph on the Standard Form and attach a second copy.

Attach attested/self-attested copies of: Educational Qualification Certificate, Birth/Age Certificate, EPIC card of Meghalaya, Home Guards Basic Training Certificate, and Medical Fitness Certificate from an Authorized Government Medical Practitioner/Institution.
Submit the completed application to the respective District Home Guards Offices / Officers Commanding District Training Centre / Civil Defence Offices from where the volunteer is being deployed.
Applications must be received on or before 28th September 2026. Applications received after the last date will not be considered.

title: Bank of Baroda (BOB) Recruitment 2026 – Local Bank Officer LBO (Last Date Extended) Posts
shortInfo: Bank of Baroda (BOB) has announced notification for Local Bank Officer LBO (Last Date Extended) posts. Required qualification: Graduation in any discipline, 1 year experience. Last date to apply: 17-09-26.

fees.fee: Rs. 850/- (Inclusive of GST) + Payment Gateway Charges

fees.category: SC / ST / PwBD / Ex-Servicemen (ESM/DESM) / Women candidates
fees.fee: Rs. 175/- (Inclusive of GST) + Payment Gateway Charges

dates.event: Last Date for Submission of Application & Payment of Fees (Extended Upto)

howToApply: Visit Bank’s official website www.bankofbaroda.bank.in under Career section → Current Opportunities.
Register online in the appropriate Online Application Format available through the link on the Careers → Current Opportunities page.
Upload scanned photograph, signature, bio-data, and other required documents as per specifications.
Carefully fill in all details in the online application form. No changes are permitted after clicking SUBMIT.
Pay the application fee online using Debit Card / Credit Card / Internet Banking / UPI etc.
On successful payment, an e-receipt and application form will be generated — print and retain for future reference.
Note down the acknowledgement number and keep a copy of the application form for future reference.
Download call letters from the Bank’s website under Career section → Current Opportunities using registration details and password.
